name: Tonic
desc: Drink for a second to heal 42 health. You are open while you drink: a hit spills it.

channel.src: Vive Brew: restores 304 HP after 1s, vulnerable while drinking, cancelled on damage; no slow listed (Hypervive lists its 60% slow). 304 / 7.2 (source hero HP over ours) = 42. Stack 8, slot 1 is the heal's (docs/SOURCE_UTILITIES.md). See docs/CONSUMABLES.md
